visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair and bangs, wearing a beige sleeveless turtleneck knit top and brown pants, stands in a brightly lit studio. She smiles warmly at the camera and waves her right hand enthusiastically. The background is a minimalist studio with wooden floors and soft ceiling lights. (2) She holds up a large rectangular sign with red and white colors, featuring Chinese text and a megaphone icon. She uses her left hand to point at various parts of the sign as she speaks, maintaining high energy and expressive facial movements. (3) The video transitions to several fast-paced outdoor drone shots. These include aerial views of large commercial buildings like Costco Wholesale and IKEA, busy highway interchanges with many cars, and high-speed rail trains moving along tracks through green fields and urban areas. (4) The scene shifts back to the woman in the studio, then cuts to interior shots of a model apartment. It showcases a modern dining area with a round table, a sleek white kitchen with built-in appliances, and a living room with a curved white sofa and stylish decor. (5) A colorful spinning wheel graphic appears, listing twelve household brands and items. The woman returns to the screen, smiling and clapping her hands, before finally making a playful punch gesture towards the camera lens.
